pairs.subject: ci-execution-trust
pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/evaluator/WorkflowOrchestratorView/index.tsx:43 The context's only 'execution' is a client-side call into the in-app Zustand taskDAGStore, which builds a template DAG of local CLI tasks. A case-insensitive grep of both context directories for runner|secret|token|signature|signed|.github|ci.yml|credential|webhook|pull request|contributor|fork|pipeline|gate|evidence found nothing. So there is no orchestrator-to-runner boundary, no build definition, no credential and no contribution lane for the CI-trust techniques to govern.

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/evaluator/WorkflowOrchestratorView/index.tsx:10 Workflows come from a local browser store, not from a delivery orchestrator instructing remote machines.
src/components/modules/evaluator/WorkflowOrchestratorView/constants.ts:32 The view's only inputs are module IDs and template IDs. No credential is read or passed.
src/components/modules/evaluator/WorkflowOrchestratorView/index.tsx:56 History is a display of the store's own local runs, not pipeline artefacts that a gate reads as evidence for a change.
